translations.web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
translations.bsb: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
translations.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
translations.asv: and the law is not of faith; but, He that doeth them shall live in them.
